name: porchlight
description: Small Claude Code mods from the Porchlight project, each optional and independent of the app.

plugins.name: porchlight-wake
plugins.description: Wakes a background session that is not running before another session's message is sent to it.

plugins.name: porchlight-companion
plugins.description: Tells the Porchlight app the moment a session asks something, wants an approval, finishes or fails; hands the session the answer you pick or the reply you type in Porchlight; and tries again after a passing failure when you or your settings say so.
